# Parity test fixtures

`parity_vectors.json` is generated by actually executing the legacy
client-side calculation engine (extracted verbatim from
`legacy/imoth_motor_quotation_reference.html`, functions `computePremium`,
`findBand`, `effectiveBand`, the `INSURERS` data table) in Node.js, across
every insurer/class, a spread of Sum Insured values, vehicle ages, and
optional add-on combinations.

To regenerate after auditing a newer legacy HTML export:

1. Strip the base64 logo and extract the `<script>` body up to (and
   including) the `computePremium` function into a standalone `.js` file,
   then append:
   ```js
   module.exports = { INSURERS, LEVY_RATE, STAMP_DUTY, findBand, effectiveBand, computePremium };
   ```
2. Run a small Node script that iterates every insurer/class, calls
   `computePremium`, and writes the inputs + `{subtotal, levies, total}`
   results to `parity_vectors.json`.
3. Replace this file and re-run `pytest tests/test_pricing_parity.py`.
